scope.description: One exact published TACTIQL refresh covering current identity, FULCRUM, Canadian testing, contracts, programmes, public assistance, partnerships and material unknowns.

source.title: Revolutionizing defence interoperability with TACTIQL
source.publisher: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
source.locator: Introducing KILO and How KILO worked for DND
source.summary: ISED records the Canadian Army's August 2023 to February 2024 KILO test, operational validation, exploration of deployment architectures and a later Additional Sale for integration into in-service hardware and architectures.

leads.evidenceLocator: ISED KILO test and Additional Sale; current FULCRUM page; NATO DIANA Phase 2 and REPMUS; CanadaBuys current contracts; independent Canadian Army Today lineage reporting
followUpQuestions: Which current FULCRUM configuration inherits the functions and deployment architectures validated during the Canadian Army's KILO test?
Which current release has independently verified conformance for MISB ST 0601, STANAG 4609, Cursor-on-Target and Variable Message Format?
What capability, deliverables and acceptance gates are covered by DJINN contract CW2434077, and does any part relate to FULCRUM?
Which FULCRUM configurations, security boundaries, support terms and public deployment evidence can be shared with a prospective Canadian user?
reviewWarnings: ISED anchors operational validation to KILO, while FULCRUM is the current product; no first-party migration record proves that every validated KILO configuration is equivalent to current FULCRUM.

The NATO DIANA TACTIQL spotlight is explicitly written by TACTIQL. TRL 9, product-market fit, sales and NSPA or NCIA procurement-route claims remain company-authored and are not independently promoted as fact.
CanadaBuys discloses DJINN's title, value, dates and parties but not technical scope, deliverables, acceptance or deployment. The candidate does not assign DJINN to FULCRUM.
Later Testing Stream contracts CW2430527 and CW2439940 disclose values and dates but not sufficient product scope; contract values are not combined as revenue, spend or proof of outcomes.

No public conformance certificate, interface-control document, throughput or latency benchmark, security accreditation, classification level, supported-hardware list, pricing, licence terms or lead time was found.
Exercise and programme records establish participation and demonstrations, not operational fielding, procurement, universal performance or customer acceptance.
Calian and Kongsberg materials describe partnerships and forward-looking integration goals, not completed joint systems, customer contracts or delivered operational capability.

LinkedIn surfaced current release testing, a General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada Battle Lab exploration and an NRC IRAP Defence Industry Assist claim; no sufficient durable source resolved these into candidate fields.
Public sources do not establish current shareholders, ownership percentages, ultimate beneficial ownership, current headcount, production capacity or a complete facility footprint.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed FULCRUM's current functions, interfaces, standards claims and deployment modes and found only three current sitemap pages.
Confirmed the Canadian Army KILO test, operational-validation wording, deployment-architecture work and Additional Sale boundary.
Resolved the latest DJINN contract date and current total while confirming that technical scope, deliverables and acceptance are undisclosed.
Resolved KILO 1.0, KILO 2.0, employment and export-assistance records without combining them as revenue or product outcomes.
Confirmed NATO DIANA Phase 2 selection and separately retained the page's innovator-count discrepancy.
Confirmed a FULCRUM exercise demonstration but no independent performance result, acceptance or operational-fielding evidence.
Resolved Kongsberg and Calian announcements to durable partner pages and kept their forward-looking MOU and co-development limits.
Resolved the published Canadian patent application and assignee while avoiding a grant, enforceability or deployment claim.
The French ISED surface corroborated the same KILO test family and added no conflicting product, value or deployment fact.
Reviewed authenticated LinkedIn announcements, resolved durable NATO, Calian and Kongsberg events, and deferred three social-only claims lacking sufficient durable support.

leads.refreshSummary: TACTIQL merits a current activity and FULCRUM capability refresh because the 2026-08-21 DJINN amendment, KILO Canadian Army validation, NATO Phase 2 selection and DMI, Cursor-on-Target and VMF functions materially deepen the August baseline.
intendedChanges: Set bounded founding and ownership context
Set dated DJINN current activity and scope warning
Enrich FULCRUM functions, standards, maturity and availability limits
Add Innovative Solutions Canada and NATO DIANA participation
Add three separately based funding events
Set executive relevance summary and four reviewed questions
Preserve existing Mission and Public Need relationships unchanged
